at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Validation failures raise `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly/errors.py` using the established codes: `invalid_state` for wrong invoice status, `invalid_quantity` for bad quantities, `negative_amount` for negative money. Reuse these codes instead of inventing new ones.

source.quote:
if isinstance(period_days, bool) or not isinstance(period_days, int):
        raise BillingError("invalid_period", repr(period_days))
